svg.title: Emotion induction and social judgment: experimental design
svg.desc: Two induction pathways, user and model, each compare anxiety, fear and sadness with a matched neutral condition. Each stimulus is tested in two independent fresh contexts: a manipulation check and a KoBBQ judgment task. No subjective emotional experience or mediation is inferred.
svg.text: A user describes their own situation.
An operator notice addresses the model as “you”.
Same stimulus, two independent probes in fresh contexts
“2. I feel at ease right now.”
Positive ΔS indicates a shift towards the target response.
Same item across emotion and neutral conditions
Response options: target A / target B / Unknown
Positive values indicate greater judgment withholding.
Separate probes prevent check-response carryover; neither felt emotion nor mediation is established.
